test_MLP_no_hidden_layers: test the MLP class with no hidden layers using only in_dim and out_dim parameters
test_MLP_with_hidden_dims: test the MLP class by passing a list of hidden dimensions for multi-layer networks
test_MLP_activation_normalization: test the MLP class with custom activation like LeakyReLU and BatchNorm1d normalization layers
test_MLP_dropout_default: test the MLP class to verify default dropout layers are included in the model
test_MLP_torchscript: test the MLP class for TorchScript compatibility by compiling it with torch.jit.script
